operations.cohort: query ShippingEvidenceCohort($first: Int!, $after: String, $filter: String!) { orders(first: $first, after: $after, query: $filter, sortKey: CREATED_AT) { nodes { id createdAt test shippingAddress { countryCodeV2 } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }
operations.details: query ShippingEvidenceOrder($id: ID!) { order(id: $id) { id createdAt test shippingAddress { countryCodeV2 } fulfillmentsCount { count precision } fulfillments { id status displayStatus createdAt inTransitAt deliveredAt events(first: 100) { nodes { status happenedAt } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } } }
operations.event_page: query ShippingEvidenceEventPage($id: ID!, $after: String) { node(id: $id) { ... on Fulfillment { id events(first: 100, after: $after) { nodes { status happenedAt } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } } }

schema_filter_basis: QueryRoot.orders query description contains created_at and test filters; no country-named filter was present.
country_join: IDs and cursors used only in memory; zero CA/GB orders meant no ID-based fulfillment call.
